EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: One of your Wasteland explorers discovered a Super-Duper Mart, but some Raiders beat you to it. Run them off and grab some supplies.
ZH: 一位废土探险者发现了一处大无敌超市，但一些掠夺者捷足先登了。赶跑他们，拿走物资。

EN: Get in Line
ZH: 请排队

EN: Eliminate the Raiders.
ZH: 除掉掠夺者。

EN: Battle the Raiders in the Super-Duper Mart.
ZH: 和大无敌超市里的掠夺者战斗。

EN: You're about to check out... permanently!
ZH: 你就要“退房”了——永远地！

EN: For your training mission, Vault-Tec asks you to prove yourself as a worthy Overseer and kill a Glowing Radroach.
ZH: 避难所科技想要你证明自己是一个合格的监督者。作为训练任务，请先杀掉发光辐射蟑螂。

EN: Getting Started
ZH: 开始前的准备

EN: Kill the Glowing Radroach and complete your training.
ZH: 杀死发光辐射蟑螂，完成训练。

EN: Absolutely! And here, take this, as well!
ZH: 当然了！这个，也拿上吧！

EN: Well, no need to be rude. I didn't ask for you to come barging in here.
ZH: 呃，没必要这么粗鲁吧。我又没有逼你来这里。

EN: What the..? You scared me! I haven't had visitors in a long while.
ZH: 什么鬼……？你吓死我了，已经很久没有人来拜访过我了。

EN: Are you sports fans? Do you remember the Rockville Ravens?
ZH: 你们是体育迷吗？还记得罗克韦尔乌鸦队吗？

EN: I used to play quarterback for them! Before the war...
ZH: 我曾为他们打四分卫！就在战前……

EN: Holy cow! Can I have your autograph?
ZH: 我的天啊！我能找你要签名吗？

EN: No, we've never heard of you, gramp.
ZH: 不记得了，我们从没听说过你啊，老头儿。

EN: Strange radio signals have been emitting from Vault 93. Sounds like old sports broadcasts from before the bombs dropped. Go check it out!
ZH: 从93号避难所传来了奇怪的无线电信号。听起来像是大爆炸之前的体育广播。

EN: Ghooooooooooooooooooul!
Explore Vault 93.
ZH: 探索93号避难所。

EN: Explore the ruins of Vault 93.
ZH: 探索93号避难所废墟。

EN: Ahhh! Run away!
ZH: 啊啊啊！快跑！

EN: Wait, my grandmother is still alive. You're no ghost!
ZH: 等等，我的外婆还活着。你不是鬼！

EN: It's not my time. I'm not going easy.
ZH: 我阳寿还没尽，不会那么快走的。

EN: A ghost! It's come to get me!
ZH: 鬼！！它要来抓我了！！

EN: Boo!
ZH: 哈！

EN: Oooo. I am the ghost of your grandmother.
ZH: 呜呜呜。我是你外婆的鬼魂。

EN: I've come for your soul!
ZH: 我是为了你的灵魂而来的！

EN: Raiders are so superstitious. Let's give them something to be scared of.
ZH: 掠夺者们是很迷信的。让我们来吓吓他们。

EN: Ghostly Gag
ZH: 闹鬼的玩笑

EN: Kill the Raider Boss.
ZH: 消灭掠夺者首领。

EN: Time to scare some Raiders.
ZH: 吓掠夺者们一跳。

EN: Ah! It's a ghost! Kill it!
ZH: 啊！是鬼啊啊啊！快杀了它！！！

EN: I ain't afraid of no ghost.
ZH: 我才不怕什么鬼呢。

EN: A ghost! Run! Wait... Uncle Harrold, is that you?
ZH: 是鬼！快跑！！等等，哈罗德叔叔，是你吗？

EN: Bull! They're after the Ghoul! Smoke 'em!
ZH: 骗人！他们要找那个尸鬼！干掉他们！

EN: Easy now, we're just passing through.
ZH: 放轻松，我们只是路过。

EN: Well, I've a few things to take care of, but I just might.
ZH: 好吧，我还有点事要处理，但我可能会去看看。

EN: Yeah I know. I ain't really camera ready these days. I'll see you around, friendly stranger.
ZH: 我知道。我现在不太适合见人。回见，友好的陌生人。

EN: Hey no problem! If you need a spot to hole up, we've got one.
ZH: 没事，如果你需要个地方躲起来，我们有个去处。

EN: They were in my way. Man, you might wanna stick to the shadows…
ZH: 是他们挡了我的路。伙计，我建议你最好还是躲在阴影里……

EN: Stop there stranger! What are you lookin' for?
ZH: 站住，陌生人！你在找什么？

EN: The way you handled them! Ain't you the good samaritan!
ZH: 你对付他们真有一手！你真是个好人！

EN: Thanks for keepin' them busy while I dug myself out of there. Was getting' a mite cramped.
ZH: 谢谢你帮我挡着他们，给我机会把我自己挖出来。我都要憋死了。

EN: There's a ruckus in the nearby graveyard. Maybe someone needs your help, or there is something useful for you to scrounge up. Scoot on over there and check it out.
ZH: 附近的墓地发生了骚乱，也许有人需要你的帮助，或者你可以去那里搜刮一些有用的东西。过去看看吧。

EN: Ghoul In Black
ZH: 黑衣尸鬼

EN: See what's causing a ruckus in the graveyard.
ZH: 看看是什么在墓地里引起骚动。

EN: See what's causing a ruckus in the graveyard.
ZH: 看看是什么在墓地里引起骚动。

EN: Rrrruuuuuug!
ZH: 嗷嗷嗷！

EN: Aarrrrrrt!
ZH: 啊嗷！

EN: Grrrrrraaaand piano!
ZH: 嗷嗷嗷……三角钢琴！

EN: We have a space for our new motel, but now we need stuff to put in it. Apparently, there's a Ghoul salesperson around who can help us out.
ZH: 我们有了新旅馆的地方，但现在需要东西往里放。显然附近有个尸鬼商人能帮我们。

EN: Ghoul Supplies
ZH: 尸鬼物资

EN: Ask about the salesperson
ZH: 向销售员询问情况。

EN: Strike a deal with the salesperson
ZH: 与销售员达成交易。

EN: Find the Ghoul salesperson to help furnish our new motel.
ZH: 找到尸鬼商人来帮我们布置新旅馆。

EN: Hello, welcome to Ghoul's Discount Furnishings! How can I help?
ZH: 你好，欢迎来到尸鬼折扣家具！有什么可以帮你的？

EN: There should be one of our Ghoul staff who is not feral. Good luck finding them!
ZH: 应该有一位还没野化的尸鬼员工。祝你找到他！

EN: Okay, take your time. But do be wary, as some of our sales staff has gone feral.
ZH: 好的，慢慢看。但要小心，我们有些销售员已经野化了。

EN: Absolutely! Please make your way to our sales office. Be careful on your way up!
ZH: 没问题！请前往我们的销售办公室。路上小心！

EN: We're looking for a salesperson.
ZH: 我们在找销售员。

EN: Just looking around!
ZH: 就随便逛逛！

EN: Furnish our motel, please!
ZH: 帮我们布置旅馆，谢谢！

EN: Hey, you're looking for help with your motel, right? What do you have to trade?
ZH: 嘿，你是来帮旅馆的对吧？你有什么可以交换的？

EN: Wonderful! I, too, love to roll in bottle caps. Well, not really, they get stuck in my skin if I do that.
ZH: 太好了！我也喜欢在瓶盖里打滚。唔，其实不行，弄到皮肤里会很痛。

EN: Oho, how convenient! For enough rad-away, I will help you in any way I can.
ZH: 哦哦，太方便了！给够消辐宁，我会尽我所能帮你。

EN: Yowza! Now there's an offer! I'll be right over with all the furniture and appliances I can find.
ZH: 哇哦！这个报价太诱人了！我这就给你带来所有能找到的家具和电器。

EN: We're rolling in caps.
ZH: 瓶盖多得用不完。

EN: We make rad-away.
ZH: 我们自制消辐宁。

EN: A lifetime supply of Nuka-Cola?
ZH: 终身供应核子可乐？

EN: All I wanted was some furniture! But I've been running for my life for hours!
ZH: 我只想买点家具！但我已经跑命跑了好几个小时了！

EN: Thank goodness. Take this gun I was going to use to barter!
ZH: 谢天谢地。拿着这把我本来准备用来谈判的枪！

EN: Follow the Ghoul corpses, you'll be okay.
ZH: 沿着尸鬼的尸体走就没事了。

EN: A furniture outlet staffed by Ghouls?
ZH: 一家尸鬼经营的家具店？

EN: I hope their prices are fair, not feral! Hahaha… ha…
ZH: 希望他们的价格是公道的，而不是野化的！哈哈哈……哈……

EN: Okay, let's keep moving.
ZH: 好吧，继续走。

EN: What? Triplicate backups? We'll just get those after we kill you.
ZH: 什么？三备份？我们杀了你之后就会得到这些。

EN: As if! We are legion! The Article 44 breeding program has been very effective.
ZH: 想得美！我们是军团！第44条育种方案成效斐然。

EN: The Vault 144 Overseer's Instruction Manual. Its hallowed guidance is sacrosanct!
ZH: 144号避难所的监督者指导手册。它的指导是神圣不可侵犯的！

EN: That's a directive about wearing toupees while on duty!
ZH: 这是一条关于值班时戴假发的指令！

EN: Standard Dweller  M.O. - predictable and past the deadline.
ZH: 德维勒（居民）的老一套作风——毫无新意，而且早就过时了。

EN: The records are destroyed. You'll never find our Vault now.
ZH: 记录被销毁。你永远也找不到我们的避难所。

EN: Not that it matters. You killed our Overseer...
ZH: 不过这些都无所谓了。你杀了我们的监督者……

EN: And we're required to seek revenge by Article 14 of the Manual!
ZH: 我们需要按照手册第14条的规定复仇！

EN: *All* the records? Even the triplicate backups? This is Vault-Tec, after all.
ZH: 所有的记录？甚至一式三份的备份？毕竟，这就是避难所科技。

EN: We won't even need to find your Vault if you all keep coming to us like this.
ZH: 如果你一直这样来找我们的话，我们甚至不需要找到你的避难所。

EN: What is this Manual you all keep harping on about?
ZH: 你们一直挂在嘴边的那份手册，究竟是什么？

EN: Yes, but what about Article 174, Subsection b?
ZH: 是的，但是第174条，B条怎么样？

EN: Exactly. Generations have been waiting for and worshipping Death because of a typo.
ZH: 就是。几代人都因为一个打印错误一直在等待和崇拜“死亡”。

EN: Thanks for taking care of those wackos! I saw everything through the security cameras.
ZH: 感谢你们照顾那些疯子！我通过安全摄像机看到了一切。

EN: I'm Drusilla. I've been the archivist here since before the war.
ZH: 我是德鲁西拉。我在战前就一直是这里的档案管理员。

EN: They burned the records, but I remember everything. Vault 144 is only 10 miles west of here.
ZH: 他们烧毁了记录，但我记得一切。144号避难所在西边10英里左右的地方。

EN: But take a look at this. I managed to save a copy of their Vault's Overseer Instruction Manual.
ZH: 但是看看这个。我设法保存了一份他们避难所监督者的指导手册。

EN: In every article about Dweller demise... “Death” is always capitalized.
ZH: 在每一篇关于居民死亡的文章里……“死亡”总是大写。

EN: It was a trap! Whoever Death is, he's sleeping... and the Vault 144 Dwellers believe that killing people will wake the Horseman up! We killed their Overseer, but we still need to find their Vault. If we're lucky, the Vault-Tec Archives will have its location...
ZH: 那是个陷阱！无论“死亡”是谁，他都在沉睡……而144号避难所的居民认为杀死人能让“骑士”醒来！我们杀了他们的监督者，但我们仍然需要找到他们的避难所。如果我们足够幸运，避难所科技的档案里应该会有它的位置……

EN: Give me Liberty and/or Death
ZH: 给我自由和/或死亡

EN: Discover the location of Vault 144.
ZH: 发现144号避难所的位置。

EN: Discover the location of Vault 144, home of the Death cultists.
ZH: 找到144号避难所的位置——那些“死亡”邪教徒的老巢。

EN: We are Death's wake-up call!
ZH: 我们是“死亡”的警钟！

EN: It's all there in the Manual!
ZH: 手册里什么都有！

EN: The quota must be met!
ZH: 配额必须被满足！

EN: Anyone that goes near it disappears. I think it's haunted! Vault-Tec's local office might have more.
ZH: 任何走近它的人都消失了。我想它一定是闹鬼了！避难所科技当地的办公室应该会有更多的信息。

EN: What are you doing here?
ZH: 你在这里做什么？

EN: I'm trying to find out anything I can about Vault 31.
ZH: 我在打听一切能打听到的、关于31号避难所的消息。

EN: The library caretaker told me someone named Herb Vest might know more about Vault 31. I can track him down at the old candy factory.
ZH: 图书馆管理员告诉我有一个叫赫伯韦斯特的人可能知道关于31号避难所更多的消息。我去旧的糖果厂应该能找到他。

EN: Go West
ZH: 一路向西

EN: Search for Herb Vest at the old candy factory.
ZH: 在旧糖果厂寻找赫伯韦斯特。

EN: Seek advice about Vault 31 from Herb Vest.
ZH: 向赫伯韦斯特询问关于31号避难所的事情。

EN: I think I have something. I'm too afraid to use it anyway!
ZH: 我想我有点东西。反正我也不敢用。

EN: Really? A Vault? That's perfect! No Gobbler there, I'll bet!
ZH: 真的吗？一个避难所？太好了！我打赌那里肯定没有高步勒！

EN: Maybe this will help?
ZH: 也许这个能帮助你们？

EN: We were attacked by the Gobbler! I'm the only one left...
ZH: 我们被高步勒袭击了！我是唯一一个幸存的……

EN: But don't ask me what it looked like. I was hiding in a closet!
ZH: 但是别问我它长什么样子。我当时躲在一个衣柜里！

EN: But it leaves behind a trail of Fancy Lads Snack Cakes...
ZH: 但它走过的地方留下一串俏男孩夹心蛋糕的痕迹……

EN: Just follow that delightful deliciousness!
ZH: 只要顺着那些美味的痕迹就行了！

EN: If the Gobbler is that vicious, we need any weapon you can spare.
ZH: 如果高步勒真的那么厉害，我们需要你们多余的武器。

EN: You need a home. Why not come to our Vault?
ZH: 你需要一个家，为什么不到我们的避难所来呢？

EN: These duds don't seem suited to Gobbler hunting. Can you help us out?
ZH: 这些衣服好像不适合追捕高步勒。你能帮帮我们吗？

EN: Reports are coming in from all over the Wasteland of a frightening creature known only as the Gobbler. We have to investigate!
ZH: 传闻说废土上有一个叫做高步勒的可怕生物肆虐。我们必须去调查一下！

EN: Gobble Gobbler!
ZH: 咯咯叫的高步勒！

EN: Find out more about the Gobbler.
ZH: 找到更多有关高步勒的消息。

EN: Investigate sightings of the Gobbler.
ZH: 调查高步勒的目击报告。

EN: Welcome to the weapons shop! Let me show you how they work!
ZH: 欢迎来到武器店！让我给你演示一下它们怎么用！

EN: We need some supplies. Why not see what the local commercial hub, Freeside, has to offer!
ZH: 我们需要一些物资。不如去看看当地的商业中心——自由城——有什么好东西！

EN: Freeside Spree
ZH: 自由城购物狂欢

EN: Get some weapons
ZH: 获取一些武器。

EN: Get some outfits
ZH: 获取一些装备。

EN: Get some medicine
ZH: 获取一些药品。

EN: Check Freeside for supplies.
ZH: 去自由城找找物资。

EN: What?! Oh, uh, I mean, welcome to Ma June's. We have the finest clothes in the Mojave.
ZH: 什么？哦，嗯，欢迎来到玛·琼的小店。我们有莫哈维最好的衣服。

EN: What's that stupid look fo- uh, I mean, what can I get you?
ZH: 那个蠢表情是什么——嗯，我是说，您需要什么？

EN: No problemo. Nothing cooler than an NCR ranger, right?
ZH: 没问题。再没有比NCR游侠更酷的造型了，对吧？

EN: Pfft. Whatever, just take this dress I used to wear when I was younger.
ZH: 哼。随便，把我以前穿的这条裙拿去吧。

EN: Now you're talking. Try these, you'll sleep better than ever.
ZH: 现在你说到点子上了。试试这个，你睡得前所未有的好。

EN: Make me look as cool as possible.
ZH: 帮我打扮得尽可能酷。

EN: I need something I can move in easily!
ZH: 我需要能方便行动的衣服！

EN: Something nice to wear to bed, please.
ZH: 请给我一件好穿着睡觉的衣服。

EN: Hey folks! What's cooking? IT'S ME! Hahahaha. Man I'm so funny.
ZH: 嘿各位！猜猜怎么了？就是我！哈哈哈哈。我真是太好笑了。

EN: Y'all hungry? I got some pickled Radscorpion eggs, Radroach-on-a-stick...
ZH: 肚子是不是咕咕叫了？我这里有腌辐射蝎蛋、辐射蟑螂串……

EN: ... even some Brahmin prairie oysters. Best in the Mojave!
ZH: ……还有双头牛的草地生蚝。莫哈维最棒的！

EN: What? Not even the prairie oysters? These things are hard to come by! Oh well, suit yourself.
ZH: 什么？连草地生蚝都不吃？这东西可不好找！好吧，随便你。

EN: It may be gross, but it beats eating Cram every day!
ZH: 也许是挺恶心的，但总比天天啃饱饱牌肉罐头强！

EN: Excellent choice. Here ya go!
ZH: 绝妙的选择。给你！

EN: Um, no thanks.
ZH: 嗯，不了谢谢。

EN: That all sounds super gross.
ZH: 这些东西听起来超级恶心。

EN: Ooh, street food! Yes please!
ZH: 哦，街边小吃！我要！

EN: Smile!
ZH: 笑一个！

EN: Snap! Ah, who am I kidding? This thing doesn't work.
ZH: 咔嚓！哎，算了，我骗谁呢？这破玩意根本不能用。

EN: I'm taking your picture. Well, I'm pretending, anyway. This thing's broken…
ZH: 我在给你拍照。嗯，是假装啦。这个坏掉了……

EN: Nope! Here, you can have it!
ZH: 不！给你拿去吧！

EN: <Give a big smile>
ZH: <大大地笑>

EN: What?
ZH: 什么？

EN: Is that a working camera?!
ZH: 这是一台能用的相机吗？！

EN: The fall! THE FALL! The hour of reckoning is at hand!
ZH: 坠落！大坠落！清算的时刻就在眼前！

EN: That's just what they want you to think! It's still coming! Only the heavily armored will survive!
ZH: 这就是他们想让你以为的！还会再来的！只有全副武装的人才能活下来！

EN: It's the eyes… aliens! Eyes in the sky! They're watching all our steps!
ZH: 是眼睛……外星人！天空中的眼睛！它们监视着我们所有人的脚步！

EN: Money has no meaning in the end of days! Only in experiences do we enrich ourselves!
ZH: 世界末日里金钱毫无意义！只有经历，才能丰富我们的灵魂！

EN: Buddy, the fall happened already. We fell.
ZH: 大哥，坠落已经发生了。我们坠了。

EN: You mean, I'm going to trip? I'll watch my step.
ZH: 你是说，我要绊倒？我会注意脚步的。

EN: Uh-oh. You'd better give me your caps for safekeeping.
ZH: 哎哟。你最好把你的瓶盖给我保管。

EN: Well, hello stranger. Welcome to my shop of wonders. I have a marvellous deal for you today.
ZH: 嗯，你好，陌生人。欢迎光临我的神奇商店。我今天有一笔绝妙的交易要提供给你。

EN: Behold! The Miracle Serum. It's not a cure, but it will enhance your brain and body.
ZH: 瞧！奇迹血清。不是治疗药，但能增强你的大脑和身体。

EN: You won't regret it! And that's guaranteed, or your money back! If you can find me.
ZH: 你不会后悔的！这是保证，或者退款！如果你能找到我的话。

EN: Nope, no, ah, I mean, it's much more suitable to drink at home. Farewell!
ZH: 不，不，啊，我是说，更适合在家喝。再见了！

EN: That's the spirit. Off you go, now!
ZH: 正是这种精神。走了，再见啦！

EN: I'll take it!
ZH: 我要了！

EN: Let me try it now!
ZH: 让我现在试试！

EN: I literally can't say no!
ZH: 我简直无法拒绝！

EN: HEY! I saw that shirt first!
ZH: 嘿！我先看到那件衬衫的！

EN: You're not taking me to those weirdos upstairs!
ZH: 你别想把我带到楼上那些怪人那里！

EN: That “Miracle Serum” we were sold in Freeside got a bunch of us sick! Time to track down the one who sold it to us and get an explanation.
ZH: 我们在自由城买到的那瓶“奇迹血清”让我们好几个人病倒了！是时候去找到卖给我们的人要个说法了。

EN: Second Hand Supply
ZH: 二手物资

EN: Confront the Snake Oil Salesman
ZH: 与草药骗子正面交锋。

EN: Find the one who sold us the so-called “Miracle Serum”.
ZH: 找到卖给我们所谓“奇迹血清”的人。

EN: Hi there, welcome to Slavers, a used clothing outlet! Are you here to donate, or are you just shopping?
ZH: 嗨，欢迎来到奴隶公司，二手服装特卖！您是来捐赠的，还是来选购的？

EN: Wonderful! Feel free to stay longer than you'd like to.
ZH: 太好了！请尽情停留，时间越长越好。

EN: There's nothing at all suspicious here, I assure you. See for yourself!
ZH: 这里没什么可疑的，我向您保证。您自己进去看看就知道了！

EN: No, I don't think I did. We're selling used clothes, silly! Please go right on in.
ZH: 不，我没有说过。我们只是卖二手衣服的，傻瓜！请进来吧。

EN: Just looking around.
ZH: 只是随便逛逛。

EN: We're tracking someone suspicious.
ZH: 我们在追踪一个可疑人物。
